targets.direct_cause_statement: The public paper fixes theta, distance, rounds, and shot counts, but not the exact circuit-location, frame, sampler-compilation, and decoder conventions needed to turn the existing proxy into the paper Fig. 5(a) calculation.
targets.root_cause_statement: The article describes the experiment at method level while the commercial Plaquette-generated circuit and decoder objects required for numerical parity are not printed or released as independent scientific inputs.
targets.next_discriminating_test: Independently reconstruct and hash the exact repetition-code circuit, error-location map, sampler compiler, and decoder graph before attempting paper-level parity.

targets.direct_cause_statement: The printed physical channels do not uniquely determine the six logical-error targets: each additionally requires exact QEC circuits, channel-location maps, sampler-compilation semantics, decoder graphs/weights, and target-specific scan or fit contracts that are not available as independently frozen inputs.
targets.root_cause_statement: The paper publishes the channel equations and high-level experiment settings, but the numerical logical-error pipeline is implemented by commercial Plaquette and does not publish enough low-level circuit, sampler, and decoder objects for paper-exact clean-room regeneration.
targets.next_discriminating_test: For each target, independently reconstruct the declared clean_room_qec_input_bundle_v1 fields, freeze hashes, and execute a dedicated scientific run contract.

items.scientific_object: Distance-three transmon-CZ heating scan comparing Stim, XPauli, and full-state logical errors.
items.authored_reason: No independent transmon-channel-to-QEC calculation currently generates the panel.

items.scientific_object: Distance-5-to-19 transmon threshold curves and the XPauli-versus-Stim threshold shift.
